## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

## Data loading and inspection

Plotting the data triggered a warning saying that the data contained an invalid or missing value. To find out what exactly caused the warning a summary of the data was made. From the summary it was identified that log12_il2 and log10_il1ra had NAs. Consequently, the affected rows were removed/filtered inside the specific plot that uses log10_il2 or log10_il1ra.

```{r}
summary(dat_unique)
```

```{r}
dat_unique <- dat_aug |> 
  distinct(sample_id, variant, log10_tnf_a, log10_il2, log10_il1ra, log10_ifn_g) 
```

## Variant-dependent Cytokine Expression

### TNF-α Relative Expression

```{r}
plot_tnf_a <- dat_unique |> ggplot(
       aes(x = variant,
           y = log10_tnf_a,
           fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Variant-Dependent TNF-α Expression",
     y = "TNF-α (Relative Expression)",
     x = "Variant") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_math(10^.x)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_tnf_a
```

## IL-2 Relative Expression

```{r}
plot_il_2 <- dat_unique |> 
  filter(!is.na(log10_il2)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = variant,
           y = log10_il2,
           fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Variant-Dependent IL-2 Expression",
     y = "IL-2 (Relative Expression)",
     x = "Variant") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_math(10^.x)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_il_2
```

## Combined cytokine expression plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
key_plot_cytokine <- (plot_tnf_a | plot_il_2) /
  (plot_il_1ra | plot_ifn_g) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Cytokine Expression of SARS-CoV-2 Variants",
    subtitle = "Relative expression by SARS-CoV-2 variant (log10 scale)"
  )



key_plot_cytokine
```
